scene: The square rumbles and three transit gates click open around you.
picture: Flat side-scrolling pixel art view of Clocktower Square along a stone ground line. Left to right: a yellow cable car waits at a raised wooden platform; the clocktower stands tall with flipped switch gleaming; the player in yellow raincoat, afro, green boots, and red umbrella stands centre; illuminated subway steps lead down; a blue ferry sits docked.
shown: a striped yellow cable car hanging open at the platform on the far left
an illuminated tiled subway entrance with open turnstiles right of centre
a blue passenger ferry moored at a canal gate on the far right
